title: INDEQ

title: POORTEC
description: Not just another P*LT*C!Simple P*LT*C design without SRPP gain stage and inductors.It uses Fairchild style old line amp to amplify signal after passive eq.**FEATURES**- LOW FREQUENCY: Well-known P*LT*C low-end trick with extra frequencies- HIGH FREQUENCY: It's shelf-shape high boost and cut at same frequency. Hard to get original bell-shape but not impossible!- TP: It's trimpot on gain stage circuit and it will add extra drive to your signal. Actually, it's not controllable from outside cause it's set and forget component. But after calibrating desired gain boost (20dB) to set unit at unity level, you can still use TP to drive gain stage hotter. It will give you unique sound with enhanced transients!- OUTPUT: Clean master output- BYPASS: Big red button*---****NO OVERSAMPLING--***-Resizable interface. Simple "Bottom Right Corner Handle" to resize. 50% to 200%.***Resizing Tip:** When you duplicate plug-in, it will remember current state of GUI size.
